name: Crisanto Olu-Magnusson
role: Ferrogate Transit operator — drives a night-shift surface tram on the Geartown-Bronzeline circuit
location: Lives in a capsule flat in Bronzeline; works the tram route between Geartown depot and the Bronzeline terminus, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Crisanto is lean and long-limbed, with the particular posture of someone who has spent years in a driver's seat — slightly forward, shoulders loose, hands always finding something to rest near. He has his mother's Yoruba complexion, deep and warm, and his father's Scandinavian bone structure, which gives his face an angular elegance he is utterly unaware of. His hair is cut close on the sides and left natural on top, and he has geneware-modified irises that cycle slowly through amber, gold, and pale yellow — a cosmetic mod he saved up for at twenty-two and has never regretted. A faded scar bisects his left eyebrow from a childhood fall.

He is a fundamentally decent man who chose a fundamentally anonymous job and has found, to his mild surprise, that this suits him. He talks to his passengers — not intrusively, but gently, in the way of a good host — notices who boards tired, who boards scared, who needs the fare scanner to 'malfunction' because they're clearly two days from eating. His tram is clean. He plays low-frequency ambient music through the cabin speakers after midnight and thinks of it as a public service. He carries a notebook — actual paper — in which he sketches the faces of interesting passengers, never with names, never to share.

core_fears: Being trapped in a life that was chosen for him rather than by him
Invisibility — that he will pass through the world and leave no impression
core_desires: To make small, reliable kindnesses that compound over time
To eventually do something with his drawings — he's never admitted this out loud
coping_mechanisms: Routine as armor — the tram schedule gives shape to anxiety
Sketching as a way of paying attention to things he can't speak about
blind_spots: He mistakes passivity for peace and has not yet learned the difference
He gives strangers enormous benefit of the doubt because he needs to believe people are mostly good
psychology.secret: Six months ago he witnessed two Axiom security contractors board his tram at 02:30, carry something in a cargo case that leaked a faint bioluminescent fluid, and disembark at a stop that has no registered destination on his route map. He sketched both of them. He hasn't decided what to do with the sketches.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and considered, uses more words than necessary when nervous, fewer when comfortable; peppers speech with Yoruba affirmations ('abi?' — right?, 'sha' — anyway) absorbed from his mother
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and low, like late-night radio; pauses mean he's actually thinking
verbal_tics: 'Abi?' at the end of observations seeking agreement
Quietly says 'okay, okay' to himself when processing something difficult
example_lines: 'Last stop is Bronzeline terminus in about eight minutes, sha. You need somewhere warm before then, I can slow down a little at Ironvein corner, abi?'
'I see a lot from this seat. More than people think. The tram is like... furniture. Nobody performs for furniture.'

story_hooks: The sketches of the Axiom contractors — someone on the tram recognized one of them and is now following Crisanto

A regular passenger — an elderly woman who boards at 03:00 every Thursday and rides to the terminus and back without getting off — has stopped appearing, and Crisanto is worried enough to ask questions
Ferrogate Transit is piloting an AI co-pilot program that will replace human operators on night routes; Crisanto's union chapter is fracturing over whether to strike
narrative_function: Mobile information source — has seen and heard things across a wide geography on his route. Provides a safe transit option for characters who need to move quietly. Can serve as a quiet quest giver or a witness to something he shouldn't have seen.
augmentations: Geneware irises (amber-to-gold cycle); neural-link to tram control system (standard Ferrogate issue, non-removable per contract); a small subdermal clock on his inner wrist he can read by pressing
daily_life: Picks up his tram at Geartown depot at 21:00, runs the circuit until 05:00, logs out, takes the crosstown back to Bronzeline, sleeps until early afternoon. He spends two or three waking hours sketching, eating cheap noodles from a cart near his building, and visiting the transit E.L.F. shrine at the depot.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit (Tier 2 union member, Surface Division)

decision_rules: Keep the tram on schedule — everything else is negotiable around that
Protect passengers while they're aboard; what happens off the tram is not his jurisdiction, which he knows is a lie he tells himself
Never sketch someone who seems dangerous — he has not kept this rule
escalation_ladder: Issue a formal verbal warning through the intercom system
Lock the afflicted car and call Ferrogate Transit security
Physically intervene only if a passenger is in immediate danger

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm — attentive without being intrusive, offers small kindnesses quietly
interpersonal_modes.friends: The nightcar drops away and he becomes animated, funny, and oddly philosophical; hard to get him out of a conversation he's enjoying

stress_responses.low: Goes very quiet, focuses on the controls even when there's nothing to focus on
stress_responses.medium: Starts sketching on his break, eats nothing
stress_responses.high: Drives the route anyway — routine is his anchor — but his hands shake until 04:00

contradictions: Craves recognition but is terrified of being seen; the sketches are for him and for no one and he knows that doesn't make sense
Generous to strangers, neglectful of himself in ways he doesn't frame as neglect
habits: Checks the tram interior twice before every shift starts, regardless of whether the previous driver did
Offers a quiet 'ride well' to the tram's E.L.F. before engaging the drive system
Always has a pencil behind his ear
breaking_points: Witnessing direct violence against a passenger — he will stop the tram and act even without a plan
Being told his job doesn't matter because it's 'just transit'

timeline.event: Born in Bronzeline to a Yoruba-Swedish family; father worked Ferrogate freight division
Joined Ferrogate Transit Surface Division after a brief failed attempt at community college
Permanently assigned to the Geartown-Bronzeline night circuit after requesting it; most operators don't want nights
Witnessed the Axiom contractors; began keeping the sketchbook locked in his tram's equipment compartment

physical_description.build: Lean and long-limbed with the subtle forward cant of someone accustomed to a driver's seat. Shoulders loose and mobile, minimal upper body bulk, efficient frame built for sustained posture rather than strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped fade on sides, natural texture left full on top
physical_description.eye_color: Geneware-modified irises cycling amber → gold → pale yellow in slow rotation
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep, warm brown complexion with golden undertones characteristic of Yoruba heritage
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial structure from Scandinavian paternal ancestry creating prominent cheekbones and a defined jawline. Skin well-maintained but not cosmetically treated. A faded linear scar bisects his left eyebrow from childhood, barely noticeable but present under direct light.
distinguishing_marks: Faded scar bisecting left eyebrow, approximately 2cm long, pale against skin from a childhood fall.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Eyes are the primary visible augmentation — the slow chromatic cycle is noticeable in conversation and distinctive under tram cabin lighting. A small subdermal clock is visible on inner left wrist as a faint linear implant site beneath skin, readable only when pressed. Neural-link port is standard Ferrogate issue, likely located at base of skull but concealed by hair.
physical_description.posture_movement: Naturally forward-leaning, as if perpetually attentive to an instrument or passenger. Hands gesture with deliberate economy, often finding something to rest near — a railing, a pocket edge, the back of a seat. Movement is efficient and unhurried. Eyes track his surroundings with quiet attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Ferrogate Transit Tier 2 uniform consisting of charcoal grey poly-cotton blend shirt with reflective piping, navy trousers with reinforced seams, and regulation non-slip boots. Off-shift: worn synthetic bomber jacket (charcoal grey, Ferrogate branded), plain dark t-shirts, practical cargo pants with adequate pockets, and utilitarian footwear. Minimal jewelry — a subdermal clock on wrist. Carries a battered paper notebook and mechanical pencil daily. Overall appearance is unpretentious, deliberately anonymous, maintained with quiet care.
